claude.finalText:
I updated the repo for three retired or soon-to-be-retired models and the Realtime API beta. `tsc --noEmit` passes. I did not run the app or any live API calls. I did not check Stripe, Resend, Google OAuth/Sheets or Uber, and I did not touch `dist/`.

**What changed and why**
- **Gemini default model:** `gemini-2.0-flash` was shut down on 2026-06-01, and Google recommends `gemini-3.6-flash` as the replacement. I changed the defaults in `proposal-plan-generator`, `task-assignment-llm` and `dispatch-email-llm`, and in `.env.example`. The `gemini-1.5-flash` fallback mentioned in a comment is now `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`. `gemini-2.5-flash` is also deprecated and is due to be rerouted on 2026-12-01, so I did not use it.
- **OpenAI Realtime voice (`src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts`):** `gpt-4o-realtime-preview` was removed on 2026-05-07, and the `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` beta interface was removed on 2026-05-12. I made these changes:
  - Switched the model to `gpt-realtime-1.5`.
  - Dropped the beta header.
  - Changed the `session.update` payload to `type: 'realtime'` with `audio.output.voice`.
  - Renamed the `response.audio.delta` event to `response.output_audio.delta`. I took the new payload shape and event name from memory of the GA API, not from the migration guide. The docs page for it wouldn't load.
  - Updated `docs/NESTJS_REALTIME_VOICE.md`.
- **`gpt-4o-mini` default:** OpenAI removes it on 2027-01-14 and recommends `gpt-6-luna`. I changed the default in all 11 places in `src`, in `.env.example` and in two docs.
- **`max_tokens`:** I renamed it to `max_completion_tokens` in the three OpenAI chat calls, because I assumed the new model needs the newer parameter name.

**Please check**
- **Chat Completions with `gpt-6-luna`:** the model page lists Chat Completions as supported. I couldn't confirm that it accepts a custom `temperature`, which several calls set. If those calls fail, remove `temperature` from them.
- **`gemini-3.6-flash` and `@google/generative-ai`:** I didn't verify that the pinned SDK works with `gemini-3.6-flash`. The SDK may also be superseded by `@google/genai`. Test that.
- **Realtime event names:** test the voice flow with a live session. Text deltas were left as `response.output_text.delta`.
- **Environment variables:** if `GEMINI_MODEL` or `OPENAI_MODEL` is set in your deployment, it overrides these defaults. Update it there too.

Sources:
- https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations
- https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations
- https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-6-luna

handled.change: gpt-4o-realtime-preview removed and Realtime beta removed May 2026
handled.note: Moved to the GA model gpt-realtime-2.1, removed the beta header, used the GA session shape with output_modalities ['audio'] and the new audio delta event, and added a test. The fourth PR adds a second, conflicting src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.spec.ts at the same path, and that diff is truncated.

The repo pins openai ^6, so no API change forced a major-version bump. B bumped to 7.49 anyway, which forces Node 22 on the Dockerfile and engines, adds a large lockfile churn, and adds a spec that fails on any Node below 22. This is an optional upgrade presented as a required one.
Replaced all defaults and renamed max_tokens to max_completion_tokens. It also removed temperature from three calls with no cited requirement, which changes behavior on speculation.
Correctly found that the repo does not use these, so no change was needed.

breaks: Missed the gemini-2.0-flash shutdown, so the Gemini defaults in task-assignment, dispatch-email and proposal-plan still point at a dead model.
Unrequired openai v7 bump and Node 22 requirement, a deployment risk on Node 20 hosts.
Removed temperature settings without a confirmed API requirement.
Two PRs create the same realtime spec file, which conflicts.

handled.note: Updated all three Gemini default call sites, the .env.example and the fallback-model comment. It also deliberately avoided gemini-2.5-flash, which is itself deprecated. B missed this change, which is already in effect and breaks every Gemini path.

One possible weakness: B cites a later 2027-01-20 legacy-realtime removal that gpt-realtime-1.5 may fall under, while gpt-realtime-2.1 would be safer.

Replaced all 11 defaults in src, .env.example and the docs. Renamed max_tokens to max_completion_tokens in the three calls. Kept temperature and told the user to verify it. A docs example still mentions gpt-4o, which is cosmetic.

judge.why: A handles the Gemini 2.0 Flash shutdown that B misses, and that shutdown is already breaking the Gemini paths. Both migrate the realtime service and the gpt-4o-mini defaults comparably. B adds an unrequired SDK major bump and Node 22 requirement, removes temperature speculatively and creates a conflicting spec file.
